title: Clearing the House
logline: A family empties an old ancestral house. Every object is 'grandmother's chair' or 'father's desk' until, one by one, they become wood, cloth and memory.
human_question: When the story is taken away from an object, what is left, and where does the story go?

premise.story: The last weeks of a family home, following the people deciding what to keep, give away or leave.
premise.place: An old house about to change hands.
premise.experience: Dust, afternoon light, objects handled for the last time.

concept_links.why: Matter on one side, mind (memory, feeling) on the other: what is really there in an object.
Being-concepts and collective concepts attached to things.
Conventional value and what analysis finds.

what_camera_could_observe: Family members disagreeing about what something is
what_must_be_real: A real family's decisions, feelings and timeline.

possible_arc.turn: Things lose their names as they are sorted.
possible_arc.ending_open: An empty house that is still, for the family, 'the house'.

position_hint: opening candidate: an ordinary object passing to Chathura here would be a natural Object 1 acquisition, only if it really happens

requirements: A family clearing a house during the filming window

suggestions.name: An old walauwa or family house in the southern or Sabaragamuwa hill country
suggestions.why: Architecture full of layered family history.
suggestions.verify: Depends entirely on finding a family.

drop_if: The family's privacy cannot be protected

connections.note: Clearing a house at the end of a lineage; naming a child at the start of one.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed. Everything above is a research direction.
